footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to American Homes 4 Rent: after $74.4M attributable to noncontrolling interests. The income statement has no operating income line; it is shown here as revenue less the operating expense lines, with interest and other non-operating items below it.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 7.0% to $1.9B in 2025. Gross margin was 56.8%, versus 56.3% a year earlier, and operating income rose 10.6% to $683M, a 36.9% margin.
Net income rose 10.2% to $439M, or $1.18 per share. Operating cash flow was $864M and free cash flow $824M, versus $777M; American Homes 4 Rent returned $446M through dividends.
